# Cover pointer release and undo across popup size combinations

## Context and problem

#18303 requires ordinary pointer actions to join the same multi-window history as other origins. The existing `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` size matrix converts out and cancels its incoming pane; its initial release only creates the Metrics target. It therefore does not persistently guard the later release into that existing popup and its undo/redo.

The [parent acceptance receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18303#issuecomment-5563995881) records a passing local probe. This is a test delivery, not a newly claimed product defect. #18428 / PR #18430 repairs the observation and restores the existing matrix; its approved scope stays frozen.

## Architectural reality and fix

Extend the existing E2E spec only. Share its ordinary pointer setup between the original restore terminal and a new commit terminal, retaining the four existing size combinations. Observe `getWorkspaceDocument`, pane identity, native lifecycle records and the Group's existing history. No production helper, wire format, dependency or gesture behavior changes.

The source popup is provisional: semantic transfer is **main → existing popup**. Native titlebar transfer between committed popup workspaces remains separate. Target positioning can append `native-popup-move` rows, so identify the incoming pane's `dock-transfer` row rather than counting every cursor increment as a drop.

| Surface | Authority | Required observation | Failure behavior | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pointer terminal and history | Real pointer release, current documents, pane and native owners, Group rows | Not committed while held; one two-participant transfer on release; undo and redo preserve pane identity | Fail on early commit, wrong destination, duplicate DOM, retained source, or extra pane transfer | Four headed size cases and cancellation control |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve the first-terminal and all four existing overlap/restore journeys.
- [ ] Register a normal release test for each existing size selection, with no temporary probe flag. Before release, the pane remains in main and has no transfer row; after release, both panes are in the target, the same incoming pane has one visible DOM element, and its provisional source retires.
- [ ] Exactly one incoming `dock-transfer` row spans main and target; one undo visibly returns the pane to main, and redo visibly restores it to the existing target without adding history.
- [ ] All four release cases pass headed. Escape before release turns the terminal assertion red. Record receipts outside CI without claiming hosted coverage.

## Out of scope

Production changes, root-edge policy, theming, the second-independent-root case, CI enablement, and changes to #18430. Merge the reader prerequisite before publishing this standalone test PR against `dev`.

Decision Record impact: aligned with ADR 0029; no amendment or new module.

Live latest-20 open issues and latest-30 all-state A2A messages checked immediately before creation (2026-09-07 02:23 UTC); no competing terminal-test leaf or claim. Exact all-state pointer-release search found the distinct first-terminal #18409 and readiness #18428.
